plan.summary: Wire RI insight outputs into Knowledge, Outbound, and Marketing services via Backend orchestration endpoints, plus add Template CRUD UI to Dashboard. 4 phases: P1 Knowledge sync, P2 Outbound rescue trigger, P3 Template CRUD, P4 Marketing sync.
plan.q_intent: Hemen Yapilabilir (altyapi hazir, sadece wiring) listesi icin plan hazirla — cross-service entegrasyonlar
plan.interview_notes: FB-5a skipped (obsolete — FlowBuilder already merged into Dashboard SPA). RI-8.8 deferred (stages→FlowGraphV2 non-trivial). ConversationId = CustomerPhoneNumber (no schema change needed for P2).

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/ops/ri/sync-knowledge/{tenantId} reads WA sector templates and creates Knowledge intents+FAQs idempotently
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Endpoint implemented in Backend Program.cs, handles 409 (duplicate) as skip

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/ops/ri/rescue-trigger/{tenantId} fetches rescue candidates, triggers Outbound for pending high-priority ones, updates status to triggered
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Endpoint implemented, uses conversationId as phone, calls Outbound webhook/trigger

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Template CRUD endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE) work for all 4 types (intent, faq, objection_handler, followup_template) in WA
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: 12 endpoint handlers added to WA Program.cs + 8 repository methods

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dashboard RiTemplateManagementPage renders 4 tabs with search, inline add/edit, toggle, soft delete
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: New page created, route added, sidebar link added

acceptance_criteria.criterion: POST /api/ops/ri/sync-marketing/{tenantId} syncs objections as risks and templates as rescue templates to Marketing
acceptance_criteria.verification_note: Endpoint implemented, maps objection types to risk levels and templates to rescue strategies

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Full solution builds with zero errors after all 4 phases

files_changed.change: Added 3 orchestration endpoints: sync-knowledge (P1), rescue-trigger (P2), sync-marketing (P4)
Added error entries for 6 new codes
Added CRUD endpoints (POST/PUT/DELETE) for 4 template types + rescue status PUT
Added 8 single-record CRUD methods (Insert/Update per type)
New tabbed CRUD page for RI template management
Added lazy import + route for RiTemplateManagementPage
Added Layers icon + sidebar nav item for RI Sablonlari

verification_questions.question: Do the Backend orchestration endpoints properly validate OpsKey auth and tenant JWT before making cross-service calls?
Are WA template CRUD endpoints properly tenant-isolated via GetValidatedTenant check, preventing cross-tenant data access?
Does the Knowledge sync handle duplicate entries idempotently (409 response) without creating data corruption?
Does the rescue trigger correctly filter by status=pending and priority threshold before triggering Outbound, and update status atomically?
Are all error paths in cross-service calls logged with appropriate error codes and returned as structured ErrorResponse?

intentional_exclusions: No new DB tables or columns
No changes to target services (Knowledge, Outbound, Marketing)

user_facing_errors: INV-BE-071: Rescue trigger to Outbound failed
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All cross-service call failures are logged and counted in response (errors field). Individual item failures don't halt the batch — they increment error counter and continue.

aha_moments.user_pain: Sales team doesn't know which lost customers can still be rescued — rescue candidates sit in dashboard unseen
aha_moments.suggestion: Auto-trigger outbound follow-up for high-priority rescue candidates, so no hot lead goes cold
aha_moments.aha_moment: Agent gets a notification to follow up with a customer who was about to leave — and wins them back

aha_moments.user_pain: Customer objections repeat across conversations but support agents don't have pre-built responses
aha_moments.suggestion: Sync RI-mined FAQs and intents to Knowledge base so chatbot auto-handles common objections
aha_moments.aha_moment: Chatbot answers a price objection with a tailored response — customer feels understood without waiting for an agent

aha_moments.user_pain: Template management requires direct DB access — no way to customize mined templates from the UI
aha_moments.suggestion: Tabbed CRUD page with inline edit lets managers customize templates without developer help
aha_moments.aha_moment: Manager edits a follow-up template wording and sees it reflected in the next outbound message

aha_moments.user_pain: Cross-service sync is all-or-nothing — one failure kills the whole batch
aha_moments.suggestion: Per-item error handling with skip counting ensures partial success is still valuable
aha_moments.aha_moment: Sync report shows '8 synced, 2 skipped, 1 error' — actionable instead of a generic failure

aha_moments.user_pain: Marketing team manually copies objection insights to build rescue campaigns — slow and error-prone
aha_moments.suggestion: One API call syncs all RI objection data into Marketing risks + rescue templates
aha_moments.aha_moment: Marketing team clicks sync and sees rescue templates auto-populated from real customer objection patterns

verdict.override: FORCE PASS by Q — persistent false positives (ops auth pattern, sector-scoped tables, catch(Exception) codebase convention)
